I will keep all 13.1 mu in cotton this year. I have grown cotton for 35 years, so I would stay with the crop I know best instead of changing the system. Because some people in my family work off-farm, I would choose a management style that is steady and not too labor-intensive: improved seed rather than something risky, rotary tillage because it is practical for my scale, moderate fertilizer rather than very heavy input, and a limited number of pesticide sprays based on the usual pest pressure. Since I have well irrigation, I would plan several irrigations to protect emergence, flowering, and boll setting if rainfall is not enough. I would aim for a realistic yield, not an aggressive one, because keeping costs and labor under control matters to me as much as output.
